rule: P0/P1 MUST FIX with BEFORE→CHANGE→AFTER→REGRESSION; P2/P3 backlog unless bounded high-ROI

findings.title: New APPROVED decision could move the projection on a LOCKED target without unlock
findings.evidence: self-review during gate hardening: second APPROVED on locked SHOT succeeded pre-fix
findings.impact: revision path (§11 unlock-first) bypassable; approved content replaceable by a bare new decision
findings.rootCause: recordDecision checked ALREADY_* but not the target lock for new approvals
findings.recommendedAction: refuse new APPROVED on LOCKED targets with TARGET_LOCKED
